summary: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VIII filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering on August 27, 2026, issuing 28,750,000 units at $10.00 per unit, including full exercise of the over-allotment, for gross proceeds of $287.5 million. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-third of a redeemable warrant. The filing also covers entry into underwriting, warrant, and letter agreements with the sponsor, plus related officer/director changes and charter amendments. This is a blank-check company's standard IPO closing disclosure, not a special situation.
